headline: Nigeria Sets $11.16M Capital Requirement for Foreign Stablecoin Issuers
summary: Nigeria's central bank introduced new licensing rules requiring foreign-currency stablecoin issuers to maintain at least 15 billion naira ($11.16 million) in paid-up capital and establish local entities.
why: Stablecoin regulations in emerging markets directly impact cryptocurrency adoption, operational compliance costs, and the risk profile for digital asset firms operating internationally.
